title: Translate a second scenario pack (same language)
context: Repeatability is shown by translating a second scenario pack into the same target language through the full reviewed pipeline. It reuses the established glossary, locale, and review gates. It depends on translate-001 and the engaged reviewer bench.
objective: Translate a second scenario pack into the same target language as a complete, reviewed, correctly-licensed pack.
acceptanceCriteria: License clearance confirmed for all items before drafting; locale emergency number verified and injected
Second scenario pack translated in full into the same target language, UTF-8; preserved tokens exact; register/gender per glossary
Ships provenance.yaml and attribution.txt (attribution + mandatory disclaimer verbatim in target and pivot language)
Qualified-speaker sign-off recorded in PR, independent of drafting; Tier B/C second reviewer; every Tier-C phrase back-translated; medical-critical Tier-C clinician sign-off
License/attribution check passes; agentFlags resolved before sign-off
outputLicense: Source-compatible: CC-BY-SA-4.0 for project-original phrases; source-mandated license + mandatory disclaimer where derived (e.g. WHO CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO) — never relicensed as a more permissive license
